case_title: MARIE JO DAUPHIN VS WIF, INC. DBA PARIS STUDIO MASSAGE et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY MARIE JO DAUPHIN AS TO DEFENDANT WIF, INC. DBA PARIS STUDIO MASSAGE ALI KHALILI ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-19-2006 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MARIE JO DAUPHIN IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT WIF, INC. DBA PARIS STUDIO MASSAGE ALI KHALILI THE COURT FINDS THAT THE DEFENDANT WIF, INC. WAS IN VIOLATION OF ANTI-SMOKING ORDINANCES, BUT THAT PLAINTIFF DOES NOT HAVE A PRIVATE RIGHT OF ACTION FOR DAMAGES. IN ADDITION, PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM FOR PERSONAL INJURIES IS WITHIN THE WORKER'S. COMPENSATION PROCESS. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
